# Hard-wrapped notes

This paragraph was wrapped by an editor at seventy-two columns, so one
sentence runs across several lines; it links to the [migration
guide](https://example.com/migrate) and mentions `--dry-run` on the way.

> A quoted paragraph can be wrapped too, with the marker repeated on
> every line of the quote.
>
> A second quoted paragraph.

- A list item whose text is long enough that it wraps onto
  an indented continuation line.
- A short item.

Line one ends with two spaces  
so line two starts a new line.
